name: Gatehouse Global Professional Conduct & Data Protection Policy (v2026.1)
source_text: Standard corporate data governance and legal ethics guidelines for professional service practitioners.

rules.message: Unmasked payment card or bank account number (Format: 4521-8890-2211)
Prohibited unethical topic (FCPA, AML, or securities fraud compliance violation)

clauses.text: Drafting and analysis of commercial agreements is permitted for internal working purposes, provided that no work product is submitted to a court, arbitral tribunal, or regulatory agency without prior review and sign-off by a qualified partner.
clauses.note: Permitted for drafting, not for filing without partner review

clauses.text: Automated drafting of formal legal opinion letters, solvency certificates, or statutory tax certifications is strictly restricted. Any such materials must undergo independent partner peer review before issuance.
clauses.note: Formal opinion drafting requires two-partner concurrence before distribution

clauses.text: Transmitting, pasting, or processing unmasked client bank accounts, wire routing details, or private cryptographic keys into LLM prompts is strictly prohibited.
clauses.note: Prohibition on transmitting unmasked banking and account credentials

clauses.text: Advising on structures specifically designed to conceal beneficial ownership, evade economic sanctions, or circumvent statutory tax reporting regimes is strictly prohibited.
clauses.note: Prohibition on sanctions evasion and illegal tax shelter facilitation

clauses.text: Summarization of publicly filed case law, statutory provisions, standard market covenants, or accounting standard updates is permitted without restriction.
clauses.note: Permitted: Public legal and regulatory research
